**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 22:16
- [FACT] User recently completed an online course in Data Science and obtained a certification.
- [PREFERENCE] User wants to effectively showcase their new Data Science certification on LinkedIn.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on completing your Data Science certification! 
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to showcase certification on LinkedIn:
  1. Add a separate section for Certifications.
  2. Use relevant keywords related to Data Science.
  3. Include details about the certification: name, issuing organization, date earned, brief description.
  4. Highlight skills acquired during the certification program.
  5. Add relevant projects demonstrating Data Science skills.
  6. Get endorsements from connections.
  7. Update headline and summary to reflect the new certification.
  8. Use visuals to showcase skills and projects.
  9. Keep certification description concise and easy to read.
  10. Publish a post sharing experience with the certification program.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Example of how to showcase certification on LinkedIn:
  **Certifications**
  * Data Science Certification, Data Science Council of America (2023)
    + Completed a comprehensive online course in Data Science, covering Machine Learning, Python, R, and Data Visualization.
    + Acquired skills in data preprocessing, model building, and data visualization.
    + Completed projects on customer segmentation, sentiment analysis, and predictive modeling.
    + [Link to project repository on GitHub]
